build.buildCommand: if [ "$DEPLOY_TARGET" = kiosk ]; then npm run build:kiosk; else npm run build:api; fi

deploy.preDeployCommand: if [ "$DEPLOY_TARGET" = kiosk ]; then exit 0; else npm run prisma:deploy --workspace @rhc-pos/api; fi
deploy.startCommand: if [ "$DEPLOY_TARGET" = kiosk ]; then npm run preview --workspace @rhc-pos/kiosk -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port "$PORT"; else npm run start --workspace @rhc-pos/api; fi
